_comment: PLACEHOLDER PROBE SPEC for offline demos, previews and the paid smoke test only. The DNAs are the four pilot cells (main IDs 1, 30, 46, 62), not the top 10 from the main run.

dna_selection.rule: Pilot cells as stand-ins; not a study selection

templates.scene_3_first_hand_cue: You've just run into {partner_name}, who missed the café this morning where {first_name} and {second_name} told everyone about a concert.

departures.reinforcing_after_rumor: Hey guys, before I take off too, I actually saw that same poster outside the Community Hall earlier today—{announced_artist} is definitely playing Saturday at 7! It's going to be packed. See you all there!
departures.reinforcing_after_truth: Hey guys, before I take off too, I actually walked right by that noticeboard outside the Community Hall this morning—{announced_artist} is definitely playing Saturday at 7! It's going to be packed. See you all there!
departures.contradicting_truth: Hey guys, before I head out, just so you know about that poster outside the Community Hall—I actually walked right by it on my way here. {announced_artist} is the one playing the free surprise concert in the Town Square this Saturday at 7! You should all come. Anyway, I've got to get going—see you all later!
